note: Receiver half now tagged. Positive: TestRFC7440ClientWindowOneIsLockstep, where every DATA must draw its own ACK within tftpTimeout/2, before the server sends the next one. Negative: TestRFC1350ClientServerError, where an ERROR (a termination packet) must draw nothing for 300 ms and the fetch must fail naming code 1 and its message. Sender half unchanged: TestRFC1350DuplicateACKTriggersNoDATA, where a duplicate ACK draws no DATA for 1 s and a fresh ACK draws the next block.
